final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT f.orderslink, o.dealedge, AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS avg_net_rate, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink WHERE f.feerate > 0.0009 GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.dealedge), step2 AS (SELECT dealedge, AVG(avg_net_rate) AS side_avg FROM step1 GROUP BY dealedge) SELECT s1.orderslink, s1.dealedge, s1.avg_net_rate, s1.record_count, s1.avg_net_rate - s2.side_avg AS difference FROM step1 AS s1 JOIN step2 AS s2 ON s1.dealedge = s2.dealedge WHERE s1.avg_net_rate > s2.side_avg ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
